visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anthropomorphic bulldog character, possessing a humanoid body and posture, walks away from the camera down a narrow gray asphalt street. The character is dressed in a beige sun hat, a white sleeveless tank top, and dark green athletic shorts with white stripes. They carry two heavy, bulging black plastic trash bags, one in each hand. To the right of the street, various market stalls with green and red striped awnings are visible, displaying goods and produce. A large yellow garbage truck is parked further down the street, facing away from the viewer. (2) The scene cuts to a side-profile medium shot. The bulldog character has reached the back of the garbage truck and stands before the mechanical hopper. They lift the right-hand black trash bag with both hands, preparing to throw it into the vehicle's loading area. The lighting is flat and natural, suggesting a cloudy or overcast day. (3) As the character tosses the bag into the hopper, a sudden and violent explosion of yellow noodles and liquid erupts from the truck's interior, blasting outward and completely drenching the character's face, torso, and hat. The character stands motionless and shocked, with noodles draped over their ears and hat, as the liquid drips down their white tank top. The background remains a wet, urban market street.
